title: SharePoint Lists: refreshed command bar, view selection and filter pills on the web
summary: The briefing accurately reports the planned Lists redesign and keeps its unpublished rollout details separate from documented release controls. The corrected release-preferences route is supported; minor corrections are to complete the fallback route in the control note and cite the background information about list-based tracking processes.

claims.fix: In controls[1].note and its rendered table note, replace the fallback route with 'Copilot > Settings > View all > Copilot Release Preferences: General Availability > Deferred release', matching the complete route already given in Governance guidance.
